key.name: dnd-manual
key.summary: Manual Do Not Disturb override
key.description: "on"/"off" from the switch; lasts until the next schedule start or end, then "none" (the schedules decide).

key.name: dnd-manual-since
key.summary: Unix time of the last manual switch

key.name: dnd-schedules
key.summary: Schedules (JSON list)
key.description: name, enabled, days (1 = Monday .. 7 = Sunday, the day the window starts), start and end ("HH:MM"; an end before the start is the next morning).

key.name: dnd-calls-from
key.summary: Calls that still ring during Do Not Disturb

key.name: dnd-messages-from
key.summary: Messages (SMS/MMS) that still alert during Do Not Disturb

key.name: dnd-repeat-callers
key.summary: A second call from the same number within 15 minutes rings

key.name: dnd-allowed-numbers
key.summary: Phone numbers that always ring / alert

key.name: dnd-allowed-apps
key.summary: Apps (notification app names) whose notifications still show

key.name: dnd-hide-popups
key.summary: Hide notification bubbles of silenced notifications

key.name: dnd-no-wake
key.summary: Silenced notifications do not turn the screen on

key.name: bedtime-enabled
key.summary: Bedtime mode on a schedule

key.name: bedtime-days
key.summary: Days bedtime starts (1 = Monday .. 7 = Sunday)

key.name: bedtime-manual
key.summary: Manual bedtime override (status-bar switch), until the next bedtime start or end

key.name: bedtime-dnd
key.summary: Bedtime turns Do Not Disturb on

key.name: bedtime-greyscale
key.summary: Bedtime turns the screen grey (display-comfort greyscale)

key.name: bedtime-dim-wallpaper
key.summary: Bedtime dims the wallpaper

key.name: bedtime-dim-level
key.summary: How dark the wallpaper gets at bedtime (0 = unchanged)

key.name: history-enabled
key.summary: Keep a notification history (app, title, time)
key.description: Turning it off deletes the history.

key.name: history-body
key.summary: Also keep the notification text (message contents)

key.name: history-exclude-apps
key.summary: Apps never recorded

key.name: history-clear
key.summary: Counter: any change clears the history

key.name: dnd-active
key.summary: Effective Do Not Disturb state (read by Lomiri)

key.name: dnd-reason
key.summary: "manual", "schedule:NAME", "bedtime" or ""

key.name: wallpaper-dim
key.summary: Black overlay opacity on the wallpaper (read by Lomiri)

key.name: status-file
key.summary: fp6-notifyd status JSON (history, apps seen) for the Settings page
